summary: Request.__init__ assigns the uppercased method to self.content_type instead of self.method, so self.method is never set and Request breaks.

findings.explanation: The method is stored as `self.content_type` rather than `self.method`. `self.method` is never assigned, so later uses (e.g. `self.method in ("POST", "PUT", "PATCH")` at line 385 and `__repr__` at line 427) raise AttributeError, and every Request construction fails. It also clobbers the content_type attribute name.
